A VERY IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
^x70FF70This build IS NOT for new poe players or players that lack immense knowledge in the game. The build has complex mechanics and very important breakpoints^7 (example: 50% ^xE05030bloodnotch^7, lvl 23 ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7)
^xD02090^x70FF70Do NOT copy ALL of the build 1:1. This Pob and all of it's loadouts are MERELY a template to give you an idea of what things should look like (Beside the very important key pieces for the build to work, such as: Bloodnotch)
Beside this Pob, Video Guide and the FAQ on my discord, I will not hand-hold you with the build. Figure things yourself as you go as there's plenty of room for customization (Attributes on gear, Tree, Jewels, etc)^7^7 ===================================================================== CWS League Start Guide
^x666666 ^xFFFF77^x7070FF^xE05030BUDGET RULES: DO NOT OVERPAY^7^7^7 ^x666666 ^xE05030Act 3 uniques: max 1-2 alch each.^7 The time you spend trading is saved by progressing and saving for ^xAF6025Cloak of Flames^7. - ^xAF6025Redbeak^7, ^xAF6025Springleaf^7, ^xAF6025Araku Tiki^7, ^xAF6025Ondar's Clasp^7: ^xE05030max 1-2 alch each^7 - ^xAF6025Lori's Lantern^7: ^xE05030max 1 alch - 1c^7 - ^xAF6025Wondertrap^7: ^xE05030max 1 alch^7 - ^x1AA29BEternal Blessing^7: ^xE05030max 1 alch^7 (Act 4 vendor) - ^x1AA29BScorching Ray of Immolation^7: get it ASAP, but ^xE05030do not pay too much^7 - Hinekora first. ^xE05030Max 1 alch^7: perma listed, no one wants it, drops like candy from hillock onwards. ^x999999(which item? fill in)^7
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77^xD02090^xE05030^xFFFF77ACT 1^7^7^7^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFBuy / gamble^7 - Gold gamble a 2H axe at level 9, then do Brutus with Decoy Totem - Buy a jade/dex amulet - Buy 2 iron rings
^x8888FFSkills^7 - ^x1AA29BLeap Slam^7 at level 10, after Brutus - ^x1AA29BSunder^7 at level 12, at Caverns WP. Also buy ^x1AA29BFrost Blink^7 (points into dex/int) - ^x999999Optional: Intimidating Cry (skip it if you can't be bothered, just suffer a few more levels)^7
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77ACT 2^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFRespec^7 - Level 19: respec into ^x1AA29BRF^7, usually after Felida's spike - ^x999999Optional: after killing Oak with Sunder is probably faster^7
^x8888FFRings and fire res^7 - Vendor 2 iron rings (6 wisdom) + 2 red gems into 2 ruby rings - Crafting bench: fire res on both rings (2 transmutes) - Keep spare transmutes for extra fire res crafts if you still degen
^x8888FFGems^7 - ^x1AA29BRF^7: buy from Yeena in Act 2 (1 alteration) - ^x1AA29BEfficacy^7 and ^x1AA29BElemental Focus^7: get from friends/guild/trade/beg (witch) - ^x1AA29BHoly Flame Totem^7 + ^x1AA29BCombustion^7: whenever you can afford it - Swap ^x1AA29BLeap Slam^7 for ^x1AA29BShield Charge^7
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77ACT 3^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFQuest rewards^7 - Tolman keys -> Clarissa -> Maramoa reward -> ^xAF6025Petrified Blood^7
^x8888FFUniques (see Budget Rules: max 1-2 alch)^7 Priority: ^xAF6025Redbeak^7 > ^xAF6025Springleaf^7 > ^xAF6025Araku Tiki^7 > ^xAF6025Ondar's Clasp^7 - ^xAF6025Redbeak^7: 1 alch | 100% damage - ^xAF6025Springleaf^7: 1 alch | 150 regen - ^xAF6025Ondar's Clasp^7: 1 alch | 20% movespeed - ^xAF6025Lori's Lantern^7: 1c is ok. We use it for a long time - ^xAF6025Araku Tiki^7: only if you have spare dex If you buy it: put 2 points into 30 dex somewhere, eventually Agility pathing to Acrimony (DoT multi above witch/templar) - ^xAF6025Wondertrap^7: more MS/DEX/INT Helps offset attribute requirements early and big RNG drops earlier - Look for more sockets
^x8888FFBuy (vendor)^7 - ^x1AA29BPurity of Elements^7 - ^x1AA29BFlammability^7 ^x999999(optional)^7 - ^x1AA29BLifetap^7 (Act 1), for ^x1AA29BShield Charge^7 and/or ^x1AA29BFrost Blink^7. Drop ^x1AA29BMomentum^7 until you have a 4 link - If rich, buy a 3rd or 4th ^x1AA29BLifetap^7 (^x1AA29BFlame Totem^7, ^x1AA29BFire Trap^7)
^x8888FFGambling^7 - Start gambling gold for gear: see GOLD GAMBLING below
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77LIBRARY^7 (IMPORTANT) ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFBuy^7 - ^x1AA29BFire Trap^7, ^x1AA29BBurning Damage^7 x2, ^x1AA29BTrap and Mine^7, ^x1AA29BLifetap^7 - ^x1AA29BSwift Affliction^7 can wait until later
^x8888FFLinks^7 - ^x1AA29BBurning Damage^7 goes in the 4th link of ^x1AA29BRF^7 - ^x1AA29BRF^7 gets priority for the first 4th link - Can wait on 4th links if no currency, and come back
^x8888FFLevel 31: Lab^7 - Bring ^x1AA29BDetonate Dead^7 or ^x1AA29BScorching Ray^7 (DD of Scavenging or Scorching Ray of Immolation) - Or bring the best potential transfigured gem outcome based on league start hype (fubgun etc) to sell
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77ACT 4^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 - Kill Malachi -> Dialla -> ^x1AA29BMultiple Totem^7 support - Buy ^xAF6025Lori's Lantern^7: ^xE05030max 1 alch - 1c^7
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77ACT 6^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFScorching Ray of Immolation (SRI)^7 - Try to buy it. Can delay using it until Act 8 (???) or until Blood Magic - Setup: SRI - ^x1AA29BSpell Totem^7 - ^x1AA29BMultiple Totem^7 - ^x1AA29BEfficacy^7 - ^x1AA29BMore Duration^7 (5th) - ^x1AA29BControlled Destruction^7 (6th) - Need to SPAM totems. Each beam is an independent debuff - Better than ^x1AA29BFire Trap^7, but not by much at this stage - Definitely aim to get it ASAP, but ^xE05030do not pay too much^7
^x8888FFGear^7 - Early game, ^xAF6025Torchoak Step^7 seems to be decent
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77ACT 8^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 - Collect Act 7 points - Buy DD / ^xE05030Scorching Ray^7 / or any Meta transfigured gem just in case cause you're going to enter Lab at Act 8 and want to have a gem in your inventory (ex. Viper Strike etc) - Take shared res (Tasalio) 2nd - Buy ^xAF6025Wondertrap^7: ^xE05030max 1 alch^7. Priority: MS > dex/int > everything else
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77ACT 9^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFBlood Magic keystone^7 - Buy ^x1AA29BEternal Blessing^7 (1 alch) from the Act 4 vendor - Remove Lifetap supports, add extra links: ^x1AA29BSwift Affliction^7 for ^x1AA29BFire Trap^7, ^x1AA29BMomentum^7 for ^x1AA29BShield Charge^7
^x8888FFGear^7 - Around now, begin swapping out ^xAF6025Springleaf^7 and ^xAF6025Ondar's Clasp^7 for real gear - Start saving for ^xAF6025Cloak of Flames^7
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77GOLD GAMBLING^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFFrom Act 3 onward^7 - Gamble gold for gear, mainly armour links and/or movement speed - ES body armour: luck into ^xAF6025Cloak of Flames^7 - Armour/ES shield: luck into ^xAF6025Springleaf^7
^x8888FFAct 10^7 - Gloves (Armour/Ev, str/dex): Life > Fire res > Dex - Shield (Str): Life > Res > Block > PDR
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77EARLY MAPS^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 ^x8888FFMerc Lab^7 - Do Merc Lab first, before or after Kitava is fine - Preferably with SRI totems + totem nodes. If you don't have them, it doesn't matter
^x8888FFCloak upgrade^7 - Take 15% life mastery
^x8888FFBareswap^7 - Level 74 minimum
^x8888FFAbyss^7 - Around 40 atlas points: spec into Abyss and start farming early bubblegum for early upgrades and flasks
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77EARLY UPGRADES^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 - ^xAF6025Maw of Conquest^7 (gives poison immunity) -> swap poison flask for shock flask -> swap ^x1AA29BPurity of Elements^7 to PoF
^x666666==================================================^7 ^xFFFF77MISC REMINDERS^7 ^x666666==================================================^7 - Anvil ASAP - SRI is bad early (no scaling) - Agnostic retro - Einhar for early and late Ultimatum. Boon of the First Ones buff grants: Regenerate 5% of Life per second, 3% of Damage Leeched as Life, and Recover 5% of Life on Kill ^x8888FF^xC8C8C8==================================================^7^7^xC8C8C8 General Tips & Ideas^7:
^x8888FFFlasks^7: Flask Suffixes Can Be Moved Around. Please Find The Cheapest Option.
^x8888FFGear Bases^7: Look For ^xE05030Armour^7 Bases. ^x70FF70Evasion^7 And ^x70FF70Suppression^7 Currently Useless Because Of Left Side Tree.^7
^x8888FFGear Implicits^7: Use ^xB97123Lesser^xB97123 Eldritch Embers^7 To Get Easy Implicits For Early-Mid Game Settle.
^x8888FFTree Nodes^7: T16 Version Nodes To Cut, Probably Use Node Power (PoB Feature) To Identify The Worst Nodes.
^x3F6DB3^xD02090^xE05030Determination^7^7^xE05030 ^7Vs^7^xC8C8C8 ^x7070FFMalevolence^7^7:
For The Free Eternal Blessing Aura, You Can Choose Between ^xE05030Damage^7 Or ^xFFFF77Armour^7. If You Go With ^xE05030Determination^7, Make Sure You Dont Take The ^xD02090"Enemies Overwhelm All Physical Damage Reduction"^7 Trial in Ultimatum
^xE05030Overcapped Resistances^7:
Get At Least^xFFFF77 25% Overcapped Resistances^7. Make Sure That During Ultimatum, Your Resistances Are At Least 90% (115%). It Is Very Common To Get Exposed^xD02090 (-25% Resistance)^7 In Ultimatum.
^xC8C8C8^xE05030Physical Max Hit Requirement:
^7Even 10k Phys Max Hit Is Enough For White T16 Ultimatums. In Ultimatum, There Is Very Little Raw Physical Damage. Majority Of The Damage Is Consecutive Elemental Hits Which Require Massive Recovery^xE05030 (Bloodnotch)^7.^7
^x70FF70Lab:^7
You might suffer with Lab if you swap to CWS early (Ramako Sunlight isn't mandatory for CWS but very good), therefore, if you don't know what you're doing stick to RF/Slams ^xE05030 =====================================================================
Weapons:
^7If ^xFFFF77rare sceptres ^7are expensive or you didn't find one YOU can snipe other types that work with shields as placeholder ^7(for example a ^xFFFF77Claw/Rune Dagger with ^xB97123Fire Dot Multi^7, ^xB97123Dot Multi^7, ^xB97123chance to ignite^7, etc..)
^xD02090Dark Seer^7 vs ^xFFFF77Rare Sceptre^7:
Dark seer increases your Max Hit by A LOT which is great. Rare sceptre has a lot more damage though.
Nethier are mandatory/BiS just pick whatever you like or need depending on your situation. if you don't need damage go Dark Seer as more max hit is always good.
===================================================================== ^xFFFF77General ^xC8C8C8 Only drop ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7 once you get ^xE0503090% Maximum Fire Resistance^7 WITHOUT it and replace it with ^xB97123Flesh and Stone^7^xC8C8C8
^x8888FFAspirational^7 = As the name implies, this loadout is aspirational and not mandatory to most content in the game that CWS can do.
Please DO NOT jump loadouts and mix them up ^xD02090UNLESS YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING^7. Progress loadouts after loadout once you complete the previous one. ^xE05030 =====================================================================
^x70FF70PANTHEON^7: Take Soul of Lunaris and Tukohama
^xE05030DO NOT^7 upgrade Lunaris with ^xE05030"10% Chance to Avoid Projectiles"^7 and ^xE05030"Avoid Projectiles That Have Chained"^7
if you did, you can revert it by using a Divine Vessel in the map device with the god corresponding map and it will toggle it off
Upgrade Tukohama fully.
^xE05030TLDR: Consume Divine Vessel Again to Toggle it off^7 =====================================================================
^x3F6DB3Freeze:
^7Cannot Be ^x3F6DB3Frozen^7 Is Priority On Boots For Trialmaster. Before Trialmaster Just Rely On Flask For Waves.^7
You do not need ^x3F6DB3Freeze^7 immunity. Being immune to ^x8888FF^x3F6DB3Freeze^7^7 doesn't stop you from being cold crit, which is what actually breaks ^xB97123^xE05030Bloodnotch^7 and prevents stun.^xE05030
^7=====================================================================^7
^xAF6025^xD02090Attributes:^7 ^7^xC8C8C8
^7Take Notable Attributes On Passive Tree If Necessary. You Do Not Need To Have ^x70FF70Dexterity^7 Specifically On Gloves Or^x7070FF Intelligence^7 On Boots.
You Can Wiggle Your Attributes As You See Fit Or Depending On Your Situation As Long As You Don't Compromise The Build Essentials And Mechanics.^7

Crafting A Budget^xD02090 Elder Helm^7 (^xE05030Burning Damage^7 + ^x8888FFConcentrated Effect^7):
This is a simple method for crafting a budget ^xD02090Elder helmet^7 with ^xE05030Burning Damage^7 and ^x8888FFConcentrated Effect^7 support. If you're looking for a more advanced version using Fossils or Essence of Horror, there are plenty of in-depth guides available on YouTube just search for them.
---
^xD02090^xAF6025Crafting Steps^7^7
Step 1 - Get an ^xD02090Elder Helmet ^7 The easiest way is to buy one from trade (usually the cheapest option). Alternatively, slam an^xD02090 Elder Exalted Orb^7 onto a base (may be expensive early in a league).
Step 2 - Use the ^x8888FF^xFFFF77Harvest Crafting^7 ^7Bench Roll until you hit ^xE05030Burning Damage^7 and ^x8888FFConcentrated Effect^7. Level 16 for both mods is perfectly fine for early to mid-game. You can keep rolling for higher levels if desired.
Step 3 - Final Touches with Bench Crafting If the item has decent affixes, finish with bench crafts.
If the helm has life and an open prefix: Craft +1 to AoE Gems
If it does not have life: Craft flat Life on the open prefix
If there are open suffixes, consider: - Any single or^xD02090 dual resistance^7 (e.g. ^xE05030Fire ^7+ ^xD02090Chaos^7,^xADAA47 Lightning^7 + ^x3F6DB3Cold^7) - Any ^xFFFF77attribute^7 or ^xD02090dual attribute^7 (e.g. ^xE05030Strength^7, ^x70FF70Dexterity^7 + ^x7070FFIntelligence^7) - ^xE05030Life Regeneration Rate^7
